Drop in account events

A CSV of SIM swaps, device changes, PIN resets, logins and transfers, one row per event. It is read in your browser and never leaves this page.

Expected columns (any order, matched loosely): account (shown masked), time, event (SIM swap, device change, PIN reset, login, transfer, withdrawal or payment), amount for money-out events, optional channel (app, USSD, agent) and status (failed events are left out). Method: every money-out on the same account within the set hours after a SIM swap, device change or PIN reset falls in its risk window.
